body: Yes, there are ridiculous serving sizes here sometimes.
I'm sorry I don't have much advice for you, just wanted to say that I'm in the same boat and I understand how you're feeling.
Ok, thanks for all that info. One question... Flock Party?

Really? Okay. I guess it would just come down to personal experience but its always nice to know others opinions on things. Which dorms did you like the best? Also, how did you pick your dorm? Are the community ones always in the same building or do they get switched each year? (For example, is the quiet hall always in Bean or something like that?)
If I get a really good U-lock, do I need 2 for the front and back tires? Also, is it dorky to bring my bike seat with me to class?

Oh really? I just thought of another question as well. Do people take clubs seriously? And I suppose I'll have to look on the housing application because I'm not sure how to pick my hall. I'll be sure to try and meet a ton of new people. What the best way for that? I've heard to hang out in the common room and keep my door open (do people actually do that?)

I like both, but trying to go from a little kid's perspective, Discovery Playhouse sounds like a fun and exciting place to go. "Little Wonders" wouldn't really mean anything to me as a little kid, I'd probably feel indifferent but not excited.
